'''Cole Bozman The Dust Bowl''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cole Bozman]]
* '''Published:''' May 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Dust Bowl
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Prem The Dust Bowl Bozman LS 1996.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Here's one of my deck ideas. (This one is a theme deck, so remember that as you read it.) So, do you like it?
